items.title: Hilda Taylor Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: Lorenzo had one daughter called Rose.

ctx.x: He lives on London between talking and voice, I believe. Yeah, I think so. Is that a son of Lorenzo? Lorenzo?
Lorenzo had one daughter called Rose. Yeah, but his first name.
There's still some of the Tio's living here. People have told me that I never found him.
